items.title: R39 C5 hydroxylation in the mitochondrion with COQ6 and COQ8; remove the cytosolic excursion
items.note: 2026-10-08 package A1: C5 hydroxylation moved to the mitochondrion (R969/R808 cytosolic excursion removed, as in the human-approved lipid-line R39 topology); GPR COQ6 candidate AND COQ8 candidate. COQ8 is a complex-stability co-requirement (S. cerevisiae coq8/abc1 nulls arrest at HHB, Do et al. 2001 JBC PMID 11279158), not a catalytic claim. The 0.5 O2 lump without Yah1/Arh1 electron donor is retained.

evidence.claim: R39 mitochondrial topology without R969/R808 was human-approved on the lipid line
S. cerevisiae abc1/coq8 null mutants accumulate 3-hexaprenyl-4-hydroxybenzoate (HHB, the R39 substrate) as the predominant intermediate
evidence.source: Do et al. 2001 J Biol Chem, PMID 11279158
evidence.caveat: S. cerevisiae; every coq3-coq9 null arrests at HHB because the Coq complex is unstable (Xie et al. 2012 JBC, PMC3390632, reviewer-opened). Supports co-requirement for the first ring modification, not a catalytic role.

evidence.claim: Coq6 performs the C5 hydroxylation of the HHB ring
evidence.source: Ozeir et al. 2011 Chem Biol PMID 21944752; Ozeir et al. 2015 JBC PMC4591803
evidence.caveat: S. cerevisiae; Yarrowia COQ6 candidate assignment is by homology.

items.note: 2026-10-08 package B1: single complex I reaction (R1889 merged here), 4 H+ pumped per NADH (Y. lipolytica 3.6-3.8 H+/2e-, Galkin et al. 2006 BBA PMID 17094937). GPR = model complex-I genes matched to PDB 6YJ4 subunits (22 at protein level; 4 at locus level whose W29 protein records are opposite-strand ORFs); NDH2 (YALI1F32476g) and NDH-2-family YALI1E06573g removed (not in 6YJ4).

evidence.claim: Deficiencies in nuclear genes for central complex I subunits are lethal in Y. lipolytica; only a matrix-facing (internal) NDH2 rescues them
evidence.source: Kerscher et al. 2001 J Cell Sci 114:3915, PMID 11719558

evidence.claim: Y. lipolytica NDH2 (YALI0F25135g) is external and the only alternative NADH dehydrogenase gene; ndh2 deletions are fully viable
evidence.source: Kerscher, Okun & Brandt 1999 J Cell Sci 112:2347, PMID 10381390; UniProt F2Z699

evidence.claim: Y. lipolytica complex I translocates about 4 H+ per NADH (3.8 in mitochondria, 3.6 reconstituted)
Every retained R2062 gene corresponds to a subunit of Y. lipolytica complex I PDB 6YJ4 (22 matched at protein level, 4 at locus level only); NDH2 and YALI1E06573g (NDH-2 family) do not
evidence.source: RCSB data API 6YJ4 polymer entities 1-42, UniProt and NCBI protein records, in-memory alignment
evidence.caveat: YALI1D00766g (NUHM), YALI1F03371g (NUGM), YALI1D32550g (NUEM), YALI1E27218g (NUFM): the YALI0 locus encodes the subunit, but the W29 GenBank protein record is an opposite-strand ORF; locus-level membership retained, identity_review not verified. YALI1M00338r is ND5 (AOW08010.1, gene nad5), not an RNA gene, and is retained. 6YJ4 subunits with no model gene in the rule (e.g. ACPM2 YALI1D32594g) are not added.

gene_membership.rule: User decision D (2026-10-08): keep subunits whose yeast deletion abolishes complex IV assembly or activity; remove proven non-members; keep mtDNA-encoded catalytic core (out of benchmark scope); settle R2206 genes before merging.

retained.YALI1M00131g: COX1 (YalifMp03, Q9B6E7, reviewed COX1_YARLI); catalytic core, missing from R304 before; added from R2206
retained.YALI1E23635g: Cox4 ortholog (Q6C5A3; KEGG K02265, mammalian COX5B); cox4 null: no activity, no assembly (Dowhan 1985 PMID 2990892)
retained.YALI1F05089g: Cox5 ortholog (Q6C309; KEGG K02263, mammalian COX4); some form of subunit V required (Trueblood & Poyton 1987 PMID 2824990)
retained.YALI1E12730g: Cox6 ortholog (Q6C6E6; KEGG K02264, mammalian COX5A); cox6 null respiratory growth absent, assembly-defective (Glerum & Tzagoloff 1997 PMID 9276437; SGD)
retained.YALI1E15606g: Cox7 ortholog (B5FVH7; Pfam COX7a); cox7 null: no activity, no assembly (Aggeler & Capaldi 1990 PMID 2168889)
retained.YALI0F04114g: Cox9 ortholog (B5RSK7, 60 aa; PANTHER PTHR28264); cox9 null lacks functional holoenzyme (Wright 1986 PMID 3023385). Gene ID unresolved: legacy CLIB122 ID; CLIB89 YALI1_F06244g is annotated as a pseudogene; not in the screen library.
retained.YALI1E19902g: Cox12 ortholog (Q6C5M8; KEGG K02267, mammalian COX6B); null keeps 5-15% activity but no respiratory growth at 37 C (LaMarche 1992 PMID 1331057); kept as functional abolition (judgment)

removed.YALI1D23237g: Proton-dependent oligopeptide transporter PTR2 (UniParc UPI0008710D6C, 595 aa, Pfam PF00854, PROSITE PS01023; CLIB122 Q6C8M0; KEGG yli:2911123 'Peptide transporter PTR2'); not a complex IV subunit
removed.YALI1D11769g: Cytochrome c (reviewed CYC_YARLI Q6C9Q0); electron donor already represented as metabolites m2/m3, not a subunit; remains in complex III R305 and the lactate:cytochrome c reactions
removed.YALI1F04455g: Cox13 ortholog (Q6C325; mammalian COX6A); null enzyme fully assembled and active (Taanman & Capaldi 1993 PMID 8395517): dispensable
removed.YALI1F06236g: Cox8 ortholog (Q6C2Y3; KEGG K02272, mammalian COX7C); needed only for maximal activity (Patterson & Poyton 1986 PMID 3023386); dispensable, provisional (residual activity value not verified)

not_added.YalifMp05: cox1-i7 intron-encoded LAGLIDADG endonuclease fused to upstream COX1 exons (Q9B6E5; NC_002659.1 CDS note); not a subunit; possible splicing role unresolved
not_added.YalifMp06: cox1-i5 intron-encoded LAGLIDADG endonuclease (Q9B6E6); not a subunit; possible splicing role unresolved

items.title: Remove the matrix copy R349 of NAD-dependent glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase; cytosolic R348 keeps the enzyme
items.note: 2026-10-08 package C4: reaction removed; see coq9_respiratory_package.json.

evidence.claim: Y. lipolytica has no internal NADH dehydrogenase able to replace complex I (central complex I deletions lethal; NDH2 external)
evidence.source: Kerscher et al. 2001 J Cell Sci PMID 11719558; Kerscher et al. 1999 PMID 10381390
evidence.caveat: Phenotype-level inference: R349 + R347 + R1977 forms an internal NADH:quinone route in the model that the lethality argues against.

evidence.claim: Y. lipolytica GPD1 (Q9UVF4, YALI0B02948g) is annotated cytoplasmic
evidence.caveat: Curator inference (ECO:0000305), no experimental localization located. Counterpoint: S. cerevisiae Gpd2p is partly mitochondrial (Valadi et al. 2004 JBC PMID 15210723). The YALI1B04433g <-> YALI0B02948g mapping is the model's own annotation. The enzyme is retained as cytosolic R348.
